sanskrit: dyauś cemaṃ yajñaṃ pṛthivī ca saṃ duhātāṃ mātariśvā pavamānaḥ purastāt | tvaṣṭā vāyuḥ saha somena vāta imaṃ saṃ duhrām anapasphurantaḥ ||
english: May Heaven and Earth together milk this sacrifice; may Mātariśvan, the Purifier, do so from the fore. May Tvaṣṭṛ, Vāyu together with Soma, and Vāta milk it out, unflinching.

sanskrit: gharmaṃ tapāmy amṛtasya dhārayā devebhyo havyaṃ paride savitre | śukraṃ devāḥ śṛtam adantu havyam āsañ juhvānam amṛtasya yonau ||
english: I heat the hot-pot with a stream of ambrosia; I present the oblation to Savitṛ for the gods. May the gods eat the bright, well-cooked oblation, while the offerer pours into the womb of immortality.

sanskrit: ud vāsayāgneḥ śṛtam akarma havyam ā roha pṛṣṭham amṛtasya dhāma | vanaspataya upa barhi stṛṇīta madhvā samantaṃ ghṛtavat karātha ||
english: We have caused the oblation cooked on Agni's fire to send up its fragrance; mount the back of the immortal abode. O forest-lords, strew the sacred grass; make it all around sweet as honey, rich as ghee.

sanskrit: yo 'psu yakṣmaḥ śamayāmi taṃ va ūrjā gavyūtiṃ sam anajmy etām | stanyaṃ kṣīram aviṣaṃ vaḥ kṛṇomy asuṃ dhayanto 'pi yūtham eta ||
english: Whatever disease-demon lurks in the waters, I appease him for you; I anoint this pasture-land with nourishing strength. I make the suckling milk uncontaminated for you; drinking life-breath, come back to the herd.

sanskrit: iḍānāṃ putrā uta mitriyāṇāṃ payo dhayantv ahṛṇīyamānāḥ | ṛtubhiḥ sasyam uta kl̥ptam astv iryo gopā rakṣatu vāyur enāḥ ||
english: May the sons of Iḍā and of the friendly cows suck their milk unharmed, without injury. May the crops be well-tended according to the seasons; may Iryā the herdsman and Vāyu guard them.

sanskrit: pibata ghṛtaṃ yatidhā va etad guhā hitaṃ nihitaṃ mānaveṣu | viśve devā vaiśvadevaś cāgnau yathābhāgaṃ haviṣo mādayadhvam ||
english: Drink this ghee in due measure—it is secretly placed, deposited among human beings. All you gods, and Vaiśvadeva in Agni, rejoice in the oblation, each according to his share.

sanskrit: yo devānām asi śreṣṭho rudras tanticaro vṛṣā | ariṣṭā asmākaṃ vīrā etad astu hutaṃ tava ||
english: You who are the foremost of the gods, O Rudra, the bull who roams the threads of sacrifice—may our heroes be unharmed; let this oblation be offered to you.

sanskrit: pūrṇam ahaṃ karīṣiṇaṃ śatavantaṃ sahasriṇam | viśvebhir agne devair imaṃ goṣṭhaṃ sahāruham ||
english: Full of dung-fuel, possessed of hundreds, possessed of thousands—I have mounted this cow-pen together with all the gods, O Agni.

sanskrit: devainasād unmaditaṃ kṣetriyāc chapathād uta | muñcantu tasmāt tvā devā unmattaṃ rakṣasas pari ||
english: From sin against the gods, from hereditary disease, and from the curse—may the gods free you, maddened and beset by demons, from all of that.

sanskrit: muniṃ bhavantaṃ pari yāni vāvṛtū rakṣāṃsy agna ululā karikratu | atas tvaṃ no adhi pāhi vājinn indreṇa medī bṛhate raṇāya ||
english: The demons that have encircled you as you became a seer, O Agni, howling and shrieking around you—from these protect us, O prize-winner, allied with Indra, for the great battle.

sanskrit: yathāgne devā ṛbhavo manīṣiṇo munim unmattam asṛjan nir enasaḥ | evā te śakro abhayaṃ kṛṇotu mucyasvainaso vi nayāmi rakṣaḥ ||
english: Just as the gods, the wise Ṛbhus, O Agni, released the maddened seer free from sin—so may Śakra grant you fearlessness; be freed from sin; I drive away the demon.

sanskrit: yathā gāvaś ca bhūmyāṃ puruṣāś ca nyokasaḥ | evonmattasya te mune gṛhṇātu pṛthivī manaḥ ||
english: Just as cattle and men are settled in their home upon the earth—so may Earth seize the mind of you, the maddened seer, and restore it.

sanskrit: muniṃ dādhāra pṛthivī muniṃ dyaur abhi rakṣati | muniṃ hi viśvā bhūtāni munim indro adīdharat parā rakṣaḥ suvāmi te ||
english: Earth has upheld the seer; Heaven guards the seer. All living beings hold the seer; Indra himself sustained the seer. I drive away the demon far from you.

sanskrit: imaṃ me agne puruṣaṃ mumugdhi ya āvitto grāhyā lālapīti | ato *'dhi te kṛṇavad bhāgadheyam anunmadito agado yathāsat ||
english: Release this man for me, O Agni—he who, seized by a Grāhī-demoness, babbles incoherently. From that state may he then make your ritual portion, so that he may be un-maddened and free from affliction.

sanskrit: agniṣ ṭe ni śamayatu yat ta etan mana uhyate | juhomi vidvāṃs te havir yathānunmadito bhuvaḥ ||
english: May Agni calm for you whatever mind of yours is being swept away. I pour the oblation knowingly, that you may become un-maddened.

sanskrit: punas tvā dur apsarasaḥ punar vātaḥ punar diśaḥ | punar yamaḥ punar yamasya dūtās te tvā muñcantv aṃhasaḥ | jivātave na martave 'tho ariṣṭatātaye ||
english: The malevolent Apsarases again release you, the Wind again, the Directions again; Yama again, and the messengers of Yama release you from the fetter—for living and not for dying, and for the state of being unharmed.

sanskrit: uta devā avahitaṃ devā ud dharatā punaḥ | uto mariṣyantaṃ devā daivāḥ kṛṇutha jīvase ||
english: O gods, raise up again the one who has been cast down; you gods, lift him up once more. Even him who was about to die, O divine gods, make him live.

sanskrit: ā tvāgamaṃ śaṃtātibhir atho ariṣṭatātibhiḥ | dakṣaṃ te bhadram āhārṣaṃ parā suvāmy āmayat ||
english: I have come to you with blessings and with wholeness from harm. I have brought you auspicious vital power; I drive away the disease far hence.

sanskrit: dvāv imau vātau vāta ā sindhor ā parāvataḥ | dakṣaṃ te anya ā vātu parānyo vātu yad rapaḥ ||
english: These two winds blow—from the Sindhu, and from the far distance. Let one blow vital power to you; let the other blow your affliction away to the beyond.

sanskrit: ā vāta vāhi bheṣajaṃ vi vāta vāhi yad rapaḥ | tvaṃ hi viśvabheṣajo devānāṃ dūta īyase ||
english: Blow in the remedy, O Wind; blow away whatever is affliction. For you, the universal healer, travel as the messenger of the gods.

sanskrit: trāyantām imaṃ devās trāyantāṃ maruto gaṇaiḥ | trāyantāṃ viśvā bhūtāni yathāyam agado 'sati ||
english: May the gods protect this one; may the Maruts protect him with their hosts; may all beings protect him, so that he may be free from affliction.

sanskrit: ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī ghṛtenāpaḥ sam ukṣata | ghṛtena mucyasvainaso yad ātmakṛtam āritha ||
english: Heaven-and-Earth are sprinkled with ghee; the waters are sprinkled with ghee. Be freed with ghee from the sin that you have brought upon yourself by your own act.

sanskrit: ayaṃ me hasto bhagavān ayaṃ me bhagavattaraḥ | ayaṃ me viśvabheṣajo 'yaṃ śivābhimarśanaḥ ||
english: This hand of mine is auspicious; this hand of mine is yet more auspicious. This hand of mine is the universal healer; this is the benign touch.

sanskrit: hastābhyāṃ daśaśākhābhyāṃ jihvā vācaḥ purogavī | anāmayitnubhyāṃ śaṃbhubhyāṃ tābhyāṃ tvābhi mṛśāmasi ||
english: With two hands of ten branches, the tongue going before as the vanguard of speech—with these two that cause no sickness, that are beneficent, we touch you.

sanskrit: āpa id vā u bheṣajīr āpo amīvacātanīḥ | āpo viśvasya bheṣajīs tās te kṛṇvantu bheṣajam ||
english: The waters indeed are healers; the waters are destroyers of disease. The waters are the healers of all—may they make healing for you.
